title: 2024, Bluffdale City Planning Commission Meeting Agenda 10-02-2024

votes.motion: Commissioner Griffiths moved to APPROVE the Planning Commission Meeting Minutes from August 21,2024,as presented. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Flynn

Commissioner Swanson moved to TABLE Consideration and Recommendation of a Text Amendment to Create a Definition for Satellite Communication Stations, and to Allow Satellite Communication Stations as a Permitted Use in the SD-X Gateway Zone (Application 2024-36), pending receipt and review of additional information from the applicant and text changes to the proposed Amendment. The motion was seconded hy Commissioner Flynn

Commissioner Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council of the Proposal to Amend the Front Yard Fencing Height Standards within Section 11.160.140. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Flynn
